faq.q: Do you do the whole job, or just the garden?
faq.a: The whole job. Excavation, retaining walls, stone and concrete, tiling and paving, pools, timber construction, irrigation and planting, with our own site teams and our own trucks, excavators and bobcats.
Yes. The on-site inspection is free. We look at the site with you, then talk through the best way to do the job.
We don't publish a price list, because no two sites are the same. It starts with the free on-site inspection.

Yes. We hold Gold Licence 269300C, and it has never been blemished. We are fully insured, including home warranty insurance through the Home Building Compensation Fund, and we have accredited WHS, Quality Assurance and Environmental Management Systems in place.
Yes. Commercial landscaping sits alongside residential, and our commercial work includes public parkland. Tell us about the site and we'll come and look.

faq.q: Can you replace an old seawall?
faq.a: Yes, through BNS Innovations, under seawall licence 319080C. We developed and patented a system for replacing the old concrete seawalls in Sylvania Waters with all-FRP components: no concrete cancer, and a 100 year design life. The new wall goes in about 700mm in front of the old one, with no percussion or vibration, and the old wall stays in place. We also do tie-rod installation, capping beams and maintenance, and pontoons.

site.text: BNS Landscapes is a family owned and operated business established over 45 years ago. Barry Stubbs was the co-founder of BNS Landscapes and ran the business successfully for over 40 years. In 2013 Peter Stubbs took over the business and has continued to make it grow.
What distinguishes BNS is that our team actively communicate with all parties throughout the entire process and demonstrate a true 'can do' attitude regardless of their role.
Our Site teams comprise highly qualified Landscape and Horticulture Tradespersons and Apprentices, hand-picked for their attention to detail and personable natures.
Site teams are managed by Patrick Hemsworth, Our Construction Manager who ensures that our project teams work effectively to achieve the desired program, quality and budget outcomes.
Free on-site inspection. Our Company have all the essential equipment at our disposal - Trucks, Excavators and Bobcats to ensure an efficient and Professional job each and every time.

We are proud members of the LNA and have received many awards of excellence in the Industry. We also hold a Gold Licence number 269300C with the Building Services Corporation which has never been blemished. We also have all up to date and accredited WHS, Quality Assurance & Environmental Management Systems in place.

We hold a Gold Licence number 269300C with the Building Services Corporation which has never been blemished. Our vast amount of landscaping services include: Residential, Commercial, Swimming Pools, Tiling & Paving, Retaining Walls, Excavation, Timber Construction, Stone & Concrete. Can’t find your service? Don’t worry we do it all! Call us today and discuss your project 02 9542 8900

BNS has developed and patented a new revolutionary system and method of replacing the old dilapidated concrete Seawalls in Sylvania Waters using all FRP components eliminating concrete cancer and giving a 100 year design life.
